keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «민호가 눈 속에서 길을 잃는다(문제)» 와 «눈 괴물은 무섭지 않고 다정했다(반전)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Minho gets lost in the snow) and the twist (the snow monster was kind, not scary). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Minho, a snow monster, and Minho's family
Minho skis too far and gets lost in the snow.
The huge monster is kind and carries Minho to his family.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

opts: He falls asleep in the snow.
evs: It gets dark and very cold.
He skis too far and gets lost in the snow.
Then he sees big footprints in the snow.
why: 민호가 너무 멀리까지 스키를 타서 눈 속에서 길을 잃어요.
Minho skis too far, so he gets lost in the snow.

qs.q: "The snow monster was kind, not scary!" What does "kind, not scary" mean?
opts: The monster is angry and loud.
The monster is nice and wants to help.
The monster is small and weak.
evs: But the monster says, "Are you cold? Come with me."
A huge white monster comes out of the trees!
Minho is skiing on a snowy mountain.
It gets dark and very cold.
why: 괴물이 «춥니? 나랑 같이 가자.» 하고 걱정해 줘요. «kind, not scary» 는 무섭지 않고 다정하다는 뜻이에요.
The monster asks if Minho is cold and wants to help. "Kind, not scary" means nice and helpful, not frightening.

qs.q: How does Minho get back to his family?
opts: The kind monster carries him down the mountain.
His dad finds him with a light.
evs: But the monster says, "Are you cold? Come with me."
Then he sees big footprints in the snow.
It carries Minho down the mountain to his family.
why: 괴물이 «나랑 같이 가자» 하고, 민호를 안고 가족에게 데려다줘요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The monster says "Come with me," and then it carries Minho to his family. You need both sentences.

ends: Minho visits the snow monster with a warm scarf.
민호가 따뜻한 목도리를 들고 눈 괴물을 찾아간다.
A Gift for the Snow Monster
The snow monster teaches Minho how to make a snowman.
눈 괴물이 민호에게 눈사람 만드는 법을 알려 준다.

write.src: “I think <u>the monster is kind</u> because <u>it helps Minho</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: On a snowy mountain at dusk, a huge fluffy white snow monster with soft round fur, small kind black eyes and a gentle smile walks down between snowy pine trees, carefully carrying Minho, a boy with short black hair, a red ski jacket, a blue knitted hat and orange goggles on his forehead, in its big arms, and Minho holds his skis and looks up at it in wonder.

scenes.1: In a dark snowy forest, Minho, a boy with short black hair, a red ski jacket, a blue knitted hat and orange goggles on his forehead, squeezes his eyes shut next to giant footprints in the snow, as a huge fluffy white snow monster with soft round fur, small kind black eyes and a gentle smile steps out from behind the pine trees.
scenes.2: At the bottom of the snowy mountain near a warmly lit cabin, a huge fluffy white snow monster with soft round fur, small kind black eyes and a gentle smile gently sets down Minho, a boy with short black hair, a red ski jacket, a blue knitted hat and orange goggles on his forehead, and his mom and dad run toward him with open arms.
